subject: Economics
description: India's planning era: Planning Commission, key plans, Niti Aayog, themes

questions.stem: FIRST FIVE YEAR PLAN of India (1951-56) gave priority to:
questions.explanation: FIRST PLAN (1951-56) — focused on AGRICULTURE + IRRIGATION + power (recovery from Partition + Bengal famine 1943). Based on HARROD-DOMAR growth model (savings → investment → output → growth). Targets: ~2.1% GDP growth (achieved 3.6%, exceeded target). KEY PROJECTS: Bhakra-Nangal (Punjab), Hirakud (Odisha), Damodar Valley Corp (DVC, WB-Jharkhand). 2nd PLAN (1956-61) — MAHALANOBIS MODEL — heavy industry focus (steel, machine tools, electricity). 'BEYOND THIS HARROD-DOMAR' — built capital goods sector first, hence consumer goods later. STEEL plants set up: BHILAI (USSR), DURGAPUR (UK), ROURKELA (Germany). Modi-era ABOLISHED Planning Commission (replaced by NITI Aayog 2015). 12 plans total ran 1951-2017.

questions.stem: PLANNING COMMISSION was set up in 1950 by:
questions.explanation: PLANNING COMMISSION — set up 15 March 1950 by CABINET RESOLUTION (NOT Constitution; not a statutory body). PM as ex-officio CHAIRMAN. Drew inspiration from Soviet planning. Formulated Five-Year Plans, advised on resource allocation. CRITICISM (over time): top-down 'one size fits all'; ignored states' diversity; bureaucratic; relevance declined post-1991 liberalisation. ABOLISHED 1 Jan 2015 by Modi govt. REPLACED by NITI AAYOG (National Institution for Transforming India) — also non-statutory; 'cooperative federalism' approach (not directive); think tank role. PM = Chairperson; CMs of states + LGs of UTs in GOVERNING COUNCIL; CEO + Vice Chairperson run day-to-day. NITI Aayog: SDG India Index, Aspirational Districts Programme, Atal Innovation Mission.

questions.stem: GREEN REVOLUTION in India (1960s-70s) is primarily associated with:

options.option_text: M.S. Swaminathan (father of GR in India)

questions.explanation: GREEN REVOLUTION (1960s-70s) — dramatic increase in food grain output. Pioneered globally by NORMAN BORLAUG (American agronomist, Nobel Peace 1970, dwarf wheat varieties); brought to INDIA by M.S. SWAMINATHAN (father of Green Revolution in India; Bharat Ratna 2024 posthumous). KEY ELEMENTS: HYV seeds (high-yield variety, Mexican wheat + IRRI rice), CHEMICAL FERTILIZERS, IRRIGATION, mechanisation (tractors, threshers). FOCUS STATES: Punjab, Haryana, Western UP — mostly wheat; later rice in Andhra, TN. RESULT: India self-sufficient in grain by mid-1970s; PL 480 wheat imports from USA stopped. WHITE REVOLUTION = MILK production (Verghese Kurien, AMUL, Operation Flood, ~1970+). BLUE = fish; YELLOW = oilseed; PINK = onion; SILVER = poultry/eggs.

questions.stem: MAHALANOBIS MODEL (basis for 2nd Five Year Plan) emphasised:
questions.explanation: P.C. MAHALANOBIS — Indian statistician, founder of INDIAN STATISTICAL INSTITUTE (ISI, 1931). Designed 2ND PLAN (1956-61). Logic: build CAPITAL GOODS (machines that make machines) first → enables faster long-term growth than starting with consumer goods. Inspired by Soviet planning (Feldman model). PHASE 1: heavy + machine-building industry. PHASE 2: consumer goods. CRITICISM: ignored demand-side, agricultural neglect, foreign exchange shortage. INDIA's stable BUT slow 'HINDU RATE OF GROWTH' (~3.5% annual, 1950-80) often blamed on this. PROFESSIONALLY he's known for MAHALANOBIS DISTANCE (statistics). 'PLANNED ECONOMY' phase ended ~1991 with LPG reforms. POLICY trade-off question: should developing economies focus on heavy industry first or agri/services? — debated still.

questions.stem: PLAN HOLIDAY (1966-69) — period when normal Five-Year Plans were SUSPENDED — was due to:
questions.explanation: PLAN HOLIDAY (1966-1969) — three ANNUAL PLANS replaced 4th FYP. CAUSES: (1) 1965 INDO-PAK WAR (drained resources); (2) successive DROUGHTS (1965, 1966) → near-famine; (3) DEVALUATION OF RUPEE (June 1966, INR/$ from 4.76 to 7.50 — 36% devaluation, controversial); (4) PL 480 wheat imports from USA → political dependency under LBJ's 'short-tether' policy. 4th PLAN (1969-74) under Indira → focus on POVERTY ALLEVIATION + self-reliance. 'GARIBI HATAO' (1971 Indira election slogan). Other notable plan disruptions: ROLLING PLAN (1978-80) under Janata govt (1979-80 Annual Plan). PLAN ALMOST TERMINATED 1990 (BoP crisis); 9th Plan (1997-2002) only after delay.

questions.stem: 12th and FINAL Five Year Plan of India (2012-17) had a theme of:
questions.explanation: 12TH PLAN (2012-2017) — last FYP; THEME: 'Faster, more inclusive, and sustainable growth'. Targets: 8% GDP growth (achieved ~7%), reduce poverty 10 pp, create 50 million jobs, focus on ENERGY-WATER-AGRI sustainability. Approved on Dec 2012. ABOLISHED Planning Commission Jan 2015 by Modi → no 13th Plan. NITI AAYOG since 2015 — 'cooperative + competitive federalism'; works on STRATEGIES (3-year action agenda, 7-year strategy, 15-year vision). Key initiatives: SDG India Index, Atal Innovation Mission, AIIMS expansion, district-level competitiveness rankings ('Aspirational Districts'). FINANCING: 14th Finance Commission (2015-20, headed by Y.V. Reddy) — increased states' share of central taxes from 32% to 42% — major fiscal devolution.

questions.stem: NITI AAYOG (since 2015) replaces Planning Commission. NITI stands for:

options.option_text: National Institute for Trade in India

questions.explanation: NITI AAYOG = NATIONAL INSTITUTION FOR TRANSFORMING INDIA. Set up 1 JAN 2015 (Cabinet resolution; not statutory). REPLACES Planning Commission. STRUCTURE: PM = Chairperson; VICE CHAIRPERSON (full-time, currently Suman Bery — appointed 2022); GOVERNING COUNCIL (PM + all CMs of states + LGs of UTs + ex-officio members); FULL-TIME MEMBERS + part-time members + special invitees. CEO (currently BVR Subrahmanyam, appointed 2023). KEY PROGRAMMES: NITI FORUM for North East, ASPIRATIONAL DISTRICTS (112 backwards districts, with rankings), ATAL INNOVATION MISSION (Atal Tinkering Labs, Incubators), SDG India Index, India Innovation Index, Composite Water Index. CONTRAST with Planning Commission: ADVISORY (no fund allocation power); cooperative federalism (consult states); shorter horizon (3-7-15 year plans).
